title: Expiable
summary: EX'PIABLE, adjective [Latin expiabilis. See Expiate.] That may be expiated; that may be atoned for and done away; as an expiable offense; expiable guilt.

inlines.v: EX'PIABLE, adjective [Latin expiabilis. See Expiate.] That may be expiated; that may be atoned for and done away; as an expiable offense; expiable guilt.
